question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left midfielder, Bob is playing right back, Claire is playing right midfielder, Dave is playing goalkeeper, Eve is playing sweeper, Fred is playing benchwarmer, and Gertrude is playing cheerleader.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Claire and Eve trade positions. Then, Alice and Bob trade positions. Then, Alice and Dave trade positions. Then, Eve and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Eve and Fred trade positions. Finally, Dave and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Gertrude is playing
Options:
(A) left midfielder
(B) right back
(C) right midfielder
(D) goalkeeper
(E) sweeper
(F) benchwarmer
(G) cheerleader
solution:
Each row lists the positions of Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: left midfielder | right back | right midfielder | goalkeeper | sweeper | benchwarmer | cheerleader
1. Dave ↔ Gertrude: left midfielder | right back | right midfielder | cheerleader | sweeper | benchwarmer | goalkeeper
2. Claire ↔ Eve: left midfielder | right back | sweeper | cheerleader | right midfielder | benchwarmer | goalkeeper
3. Alice ↔ Bob: right back | left midfielder | sweeper | cheerleader | right midfielder | benchwarmer | goalkeeper
4. Alice ↔ Dave: cheerleader | left midfielder | sweeper | right back | right midfielder | benchwarmer | goalkeeper
5. Eve ↔ Gertrude: cheerleader | left midfielder | sweeper | right back | goalkeeper | benchwarmer | right midfielder
6. Eve ↔ Fred: cheerleader | left midfielder | sweeper | right back | benchwarmer | goalkeeper | right midfielder
7. Dave ↔ Bob: cheerleader | right back | sweeper | left midfielder | benchwarmer | goalkeeper | right midfielder
Gertrude is playing right midfielder, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
